offerings.name: Web Search API (/search)
offerings.pricing: Credit-based: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results (rounded up per 10 results, e.g. 11 results = 4 credits); rates are the same on every plan. Plans: Free1,000 credits/month $0; Hobby $16/month billed yearly ($19 monthly) 5,000 credits; Standard $83/month billed yearly 100,000 credits; Growth $333/month billed yearly 500,000 credits; Scale $599/month billed yearly 1,000,000 credits; Enterprise custom. Pay-as-you-go: 5 USD increments (1,000 credits on Hobby, 2,000 Standard, 2,500 Growth, 5,000 Scale), paid plans only
offerings.price_basis: Hobby entry plan, $16/month annual (5,000 credits = 2,500 searches) ≈ $6.40/1,000 searches; derived via 2 credits/10 results => 100 credits/1,000 results, 5,000 credits ≈ 50,000 results
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required (about 500 searches)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果, 按来源类型分组 (web/news/images/alexandria), 含 title/description/url/position; 可选 scrapeOptions 一并返回 markdown/HTML/links/截图; 默认返回 query-relevant Highlights
offerings.note: Search results include query-relevant Highlights by default (set highlights:false for plain snippet). Supports includeDomains/excludeDomains, categories (research/pdf/developer), location, tbs time filters, safe search, custom timeout. Scrape options add credits (basic 1/page, JSON 4/page). Free plan rate limit 10 req/min on /search; paid plans up to 10,000/min. Enterprise ZDR search costs 10 credits/10 results (end-to-end) or 2 credits/10 results (anonymized). Search feedback can refund 1 credit.

offerings.name: Enterprise ZDR Search (end-to-end Zero Data Retention)
offerings.pricing: 10 credits per 10 results (parameter enterprise: ["zdr"]); Enterprise plans only
offerings.price_basis: Enterprise ZDR credits, no public USD price (Enterprise is custom / contact sales)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 + 抓取内容 (同 /search)
offerings.note: Both Firecrawl and upstream search provider enforce zero data retention; no query or result data stored anywhere in pipeline. Available on Enterprise plans.

offerings.name: Anonymized ZDR Search
offerings.price_basis: Anonymized ZDR variant of /search, no separate public USD price
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 + 抓取内容 (同 /search)
offerings.note: Firecrawl enforces full zero data retention on its side; upstream search provider may cache the query but fully anonymized.

offerings.name: Keyless free tier (no API key)
offerings.pricing: Free, no API key required for Scrape, Search and Interact
offerings.price_basis: Keyless tier, capped per IP address per day rather than by credit allotment; no public per-request price
offerings.free_quota: Keyless free tier capped per IP address per day (not a fixed credit amount)
offerings.note: No API key needed to get started; lower rate limits than keyed requests. Free plan /search rate limit is 10 requests/min.
